name: com.ezg.figma-feature-importer
description: Turns the raw screen prefabs written by the EZG Figma Bridge into shippable feature screens: every frame becomes a prefab variant of the project's screen template, Figma component instances are swapped for the project's own button/scroll/currency templates, sprites are de-duplicated against the project, text is normalised onto one font, and the screen controller is added and wired (MainUI, close buttons, feature enum, [SerializeField] fields) with optional partial-class codegen. Every project-specific path, shell node name and codegen string is data on one settings asset, so the same pipeline runs in any project.
